name: send_mullins_follow_up_email
description: Schedule three post-session messages: a visitor thank-you and conversation recap, a Mullins Admin session summary, and an internal Mullins Sales intake brief for staff to review a quote or walkthrough request. This tool does not create, attach, deliver, or promise a quote, estimate, price, booking, appointment, or sales response. A direct request to email the recap is explicit permission; otherwise obtain one short yes. Never ask for, spell, repeat, confirm aloud, infer, or submit an email address through this tool. Call silently with userConfirmed true. Only when the tool returns email_queued may Evan say the conversation recap will be emailed after the session ends; any estimate or walkthrough request still requires separate Mullins staff review. Never claim anything was already sent, never use it for cold outreach or third-party recipients, and never auto-close the call.

userConfirmed.description: Must be true only after the visitor explicitly agrees during this conversation to receive the Mullins follow-up.
